# WNBA Projection Grading, Backfill & Category Accuracy Report
*Deliverables 2–4 · generated by `projection_accuracy/grade_projection_accuracy.py` · 2026-07-10*

## Method (no lookahead, no regeneration)
- **Input projections:** `outputs/archive/projections/wnba_projections_*.csv` — the exact boards
  published before tip-off. Historical projections are **never** regenerated.
- **Actuals:** `data/raw/wnba_player_games.csv` (official ESPN box scores).
- **Join:** exact `player_key` + `game_date` (no team match, so **traded players** still grade
  correctly against whichever team they played for).
- **Combos** (PRA/PR/PA/RA) built by summing the actual components; projection taken from the
  archived `PRA_PROJ`/`PR_PROJ`/`PA_PROJ`/`RA_PROJ` columns.
- **Best-bet artifacts are never read** — no `graded_bets.csv`, `bet_result`, sportsbook lines, or
  over/under sides enter this report. Enforced by regression test.

## Backfill / reconciliation (48 archived slates, 2025-07-05 → 2026-07-09)
| Status | Player-slate rows | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| graded | 1,885 | matched to a completed box score with minutes > 0 |
| excluded — dnp_zero_minutes | 322 | player projected but logged 0 minutes (DNP); can't fairly grade |
| excluded — player_absent_from_boxscore | 577 | projected but not in the completed box score (late inactive / injury scratch / name variant) |
| excluded — slate_not_yet_played | 143 | future/today slates with no final box score yet |
| skipped — missing_value_* | 18 | a specific stat cell was blank on the archived board |

Each graded player-slate row expands to up to 11 category rows → **20,717 category-level graded
projections** season-wide. Full ledger: `projection_accuracy_graded.csv`; reconciliation:
`projection_accuracy_reconcile.csv`.

**Excluded by design:** turnovers — the projection engine publishes no `TO_PROJ` column, so there is
nothing to grade. Documented in the report as `categories_excluded.turnovers = not_projected_by_engine`.

**Headline:** season overall normalized MAE **0.762** (mean of per-stat MAE/actual-avg over the six
counting stats); pooled singles MAE **1.63**, bias **−0.05** (essentially unbiased). Last-30-day
share within ±2 = **78.3%** across 15,708 graded projections.

## Validation
Per-stat MAE matches the independent production `learning/errors/projection_errors.csv` within 0.03
for all six single stats (regression test `singles parity with production`), confirming the join and
grading are correct and lookahead-free.
